The Spurs defeated the Bulls, 124-119 tonight in Chicago. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 32 points along with 5 blocks and 9 rebounds for the Spurs, while Dylan Harper tallied 18 points, 10 assists and 6 rebounds in the game. Jalen Smith recorded 23 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Spurs improve their record to 10-2 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-9 for the season.
